The committed artifact pack reports organism_live_engine and organism_engine_scenarios as failed because this host exceeds the generator's fixed 30 s per-test and 180 s per-suite budgets (same on 67d316ea today; both suites pass uncapped). Rerun the pack on a faster host or rely on CI before merge.

Organism dispatch follows the configured mode, never the override. The engine evaluates the effective mode whenever it is constructed (process start, POST /settings/restart-engine); the two agree because the override is refused under the research lock and, after it, whenever the process hosts an organism scheduler (running or not).

Watchlist prices come from the latest two-sided quote of the configured feed (IEX in production); outside regular hours IEX quotes are often one-sided, so prices show as null with error 'no_two_sided_quote'.

Refused-symbol detection matches whole words of the data API's HTTP 400 body against the requested symbols; a 400 that names none of them still fails the whole refresh (one-TTL back-off), as before. The real Alpaca error format was not checked (offline).
The strict ticker pattern answers symbols outside 1-5 letters plus an optional 1-2 letter suffix (for example digits) as unsupported_symbol.
The mock broker (USE_MOCK_BROKER=true, tests/local only) no longer fills market orders; local flows that relied on simulated fills will see orders stay 'accepted'.
Frontend changes were syntax-checked only (no node_modules offline).

operator_visible_changes: Market Scanner removed from the sidebar; /market-data shows a static 'disabled' notice unless DASHBOARD_SCANNER_ENABLED=true. POST /scanner/scan and /scanner/export/* return 503 and WS /scanner/ws is closed before accept while disabled; new GET /scanner/status.

Watchlist quotes: GET /watchlists/{id}/quotes returns {symbol: {symbol, price, change, changePercent, bid, ask, timestamp[, error]}} from one batched request (10 s shared cache, 50-symbol cap); the Trading page polls every 20 s (was 5 s) and now shows prices; change/changePercent are null.

Watchlist symbols that are not US equity ticker shapes (1-5 letters, optional .X/-X or .XX suffix) are answered unsupported_symbol without a market-data request; symbols the data API refuses (HTTP 400 naming them) are dropped from one retry, answered unsupported_symbol and left out of batches for 10 minutes.
The quotes route closes its DB session before awaiting market data.

PUT /admin/trading/execution-mode returns 423 while RESEARCH_POLICY_LOCKED (always, this release), 409 whenever the API process hosts the organism scheduler (running or not; code organism_scheduler_present), 422 for unknown modes; the dashboard control is disabled with the reason shown.

Manual orders in a shadow/dry_run mode end 'rejected' with zero fill and attributes.execution_mode (no 'shadow' status, no simulated fill); organism orders a shadow/dry_run configuration holds back are logged at ERROR ('Organism order NOT sent to the broker'), manual ones at WARNING; the mock broker (USE_MOCK_BROKER) acknowledges without a fill.
Watchlist polling no longer logs AlpacaClient initialisation and account details.

deviations: A3-01 (a): organism orders are exempt from the runtime override and follow the configured TRADING_EXECUTION_MODE (default_mode), instead of 'dispatch regardless of mode'. In production (execute) they dispatch normally whatever the override; a deployment configured shadow/dry_run (including the fail-closed default when the variable is missing, audit 2026-06-09 finding 3.3) still never sends them, because the engine's startup guard only checks the loss breakers in execute mode.

A6-01/A8-01: SDK calls run via loop.run_in_executor on a dedicated 3-thread pool with a copied context (the asyncio.to_thread mechanism) under asyncio.wait_for, so dashboard calls cannot occupy the default executor threads the engine uses (positions reads, features, brain saves).
A3-01 (c): the override is not persisted and runtime_identity.py is unchanged (excluded by the task); the override cannot be set during the research period.

Review follow-up 1: the scheduler-presence refusal lives in the route; the service-level guard (override_refusal) only enforces the research lock because it has no view of app.state, and the route is the setter's only caller.

Review follow-up 6: the research-lock refusal stays 423 on the execution-mode route (403 there is the admin role gate); the 403 of the frozen settings API for the same lock is documented in mapss 53 and the runbook.
